title: Rail Spot 2 Chlorine Release — Field Report

fields.organization: Teague Valley Chemical Company — Loading Operations
fields.summary: A visible yellow-green vapor cloud is rising from the railcar at Rail Spot 2. The scale WT-302 continues to climb. The hand valve HV-312 is confirmed open in the field. The DCS HMI shows ESD-310 as closed, but the field inspection confirms the valve is not physically closed. The ESD-310 status on the DeltaV HMI is inconsistent with on-site conditions.

findings.notes: Shows closed, but field inspection confirms open
All ERT gear is at the ERT staging point, ready for deployment

actionsTaken: Notified Shift Supervisor and Incident Commander via radio at 09:03
Confirmed ESD-310 status in the field
Initiated external call to EHS and OT Engineering as per SOP 7.2
recommendations: Immediately verify ESD-310 status on Triconex SIS and DeltaV HMI
Activate emergency call sequence per ERP-5.1
Dispatch ERT to Rail Spot 2 with SCBA and Level A suits
fields.photosNote: 2 photos attached: IMG_FIR-2026-0412-01 (yellow-green vapor over railcar), IMG_FIR-2026-0412-02 (hand valve HV-312, open, visible)

instructorNote: This inject confirms the core narrative: field and screen disagree. The OT Engineer must now be engaged to investigate the control-system inconsistency.
